name: Cardiac patch biomaterials benchmark table
description: A compiled benchmark table providing quantitative target property ranges for ideal cardiac patch biomaterials to evaluate candidate materials.
general_score_metric: percent_within_target_range (fraction of candidate materials whose properties fall inside the target ranges)
reputation: A niche, peer-reviewed reference table used by biomaterials and tissue‑engineering researchers for target property specification; moderate adoption within the community.
notes: Non-ML benchmark/table of target property ranges rather than a labeled dataset; small/narrow domain; intended as specification/decision aid rather than a predictive benchmark; results depend on experimental measurement variability.
